qualification.details: ATL Instructor: B.E./B.Tech. in any discipline or other qualification prescribed for ATL Instructor. Relevant hands-on experience in STEM, robotics, innovation or tinkering-lab activities. TGT Sanskrit: Bachelor’s degree with Sanskrit as a subject in all years of graduation, B.Ed., and CTET where applicable. Sports Coach: Graduation with Diploma/Certificate in Physical Education or Sports from a recognised institute. Relevant coaching experience and sports achievements desirable. Balvatika Care Taker (Aaya): Class X passed. Experience in handling and caring for young children desirable. Preference for ECCE/child-care experience. Balvatika Teacher: Class XII (at least 50% marks) or equivalent, and D.E.C.Ed with duration not less than two years.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Champhai Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview.
Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification.

Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable).
Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification.
Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview.
Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities.
Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Champhai for various contractual teaching and support positions for the session 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available across different posts including ATL Instructor, TGT Sanskrit, Sports Coach, Balvatika Care Taker, and Balvatika Teacher.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of selection for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for all advertised positions will be made purely on the basis of a Walk-in Interview conducted at the school premises.

faq.question: Q4. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 30 October 2026. Candidates should report to the venue on time along with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the TGT Sanskrit post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the TGT Sanskrit position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of ₹31,250/-.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for the ATL Instructor post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the ATL Instructor post must hold a B.E./B.Tech. in any discipline or equivalent qualification with relevant hands-on experience in STEM, robotics, or tinkering-lab activities.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview or applying for these contractual posts.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to bring for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring an updated resume, a recent passport-size photograph, original certificates for verification, and one set of self-attested photocopies of educational and experience documents.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job location is at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Champhai, located in Dinthar, Champhai, Mizoram – 796321.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary for the Balvatika Care Taker (Aaya) post?
faq.answer: The candidate selected for the Balvatika Care Taker (Aaya) position will receive a monthly salary of ₹20,000/-.
